source.title: Where's your built game?
source.description: Point Packmaster at the folder your bundler already built — the output of your own build step, not your source code. If your game was built with Vite.js, that's the {{dist}} folder Vite creates when you run {{command}} (usually right next to your {{packageJson}}).
source.browseDialogTitle: Select your game's build output folder
source.errorTitle: This doesn't look like a build output folder
source.errorDescription: Packmaster couldn't find an {{indexHtml}} in this folder. Double-check you picked the built output (e.g. {{dist}}), not your project's source folder.
source.errorLooksLikeSource: This folder still has a {{packageJson}} in it — that means it's your project's source folder, not its built output. Run your build first (e.g. {{command}}), then pick the {{dist}} folder it creates.

releaseInfo.title: Release info
releaseInfo.description: Used to name the files Packmaster generates.
releaseInfo.nameFromPackageJson: Taken from your project's package.json — edit it there to change it.
releaseInfo.versionFromPackageJson: Taken from your project's package.json — edit it there to change it.
releaseInfo.iconDescription: Applied to the window/taskbar icon (Windows/Linux), the packaged .exe's own icon (Windows), the app icon (macOS), and the launcher icon (Android) — instead of Roves' default branding.
releaseInfo.iconAutoDetected: Auto-detected from your build output — pick a different one to override it.

portable.title: Portable
portable.description: A single double-click-to-run bundle for each platform you pick — no installer, no admin rights needed.
portable.shellUnavailable: No published shell build found for: {{platforms}} — try again later.

installers.title: Installable packages
installers.description: A proper installer for each platform you enable. Turning one on lets you also pick which installer format to build.

mobile.title: Mobile
mobile.description: Build a debug .apk for Android and/or an iOS app alongside your desktop release. Experimental: iOS requires running Packmaster on macOS with Xcode and XcodeGen installed.

errors.title: Fix the errors below before generating

steam.title: Steam
steam.description: Packmaster can download a Steam-enabled shell instead of the plain one, so your game can talk to Steamworks.
steam.appIdDescription: Written into a steam_appid.txt next to the game's executable — for testing outside the real Steam client. Steam sets this itself once your game is actually published there.
steam.appIdError: Enter a valid Steam App ID (numbers only), or turn Steam off.
steam.apiHint: Your game's own code talks to it through @drincs/roves-api/steam — achievements, stats, DLC, overlay, and store, via Steamworks.

compression.title: Content compression
compression.description: Packs your game's content into a handful of compressed archives instead of shipping it as loose, individually browsable files. Extracted automatically the first time your game runs.
compression.levelDescription: Lower favors faster startup extraction; higher favors a smaller download.
compression.maxPackSizeDescription: Splits archives so none exceeds this size.
compression.excludeDescription: Glob patterns, one per line — useful for a save-data or user-config folder that needs to stay as plain, writable files.
compression.bootIncludeDescription: Glob patterns, one per line, for extra files needed as soon as your game starts (beyond your HTML file and whatever it directly references).

mobileAdvanced.title: Advanced settings
mobileAdvanced.description: Android app name, screen orientation, and release signing.
mobileAdvanced.useWebManifestLabel: Use info from your web app manifest
mobileAdvanced.useWebManifestFound: Found {{file}} in your build output — using its name and orientation. Turn this off to set them manually instead.
mobileAdvanced.useWebManifestNotFound: No manifest.webmanifest, manifest.json, or site.webmanifest found in your build output — set these manually below, or add one to your project.

signing.title: Release signing
signing.description: Build a real, signed .apk instead of a debug-only one. Needed before an APK can be installed as an update to a previous release, or published anywhere.

iosAdvanced.title: Advanced settings
iosAdvanced.description: iOS app name, bundle identifier, and release signing.

signing.title: Release signing
signing.description: Archive and export a real, signed .ipa instead of an unsigned Simulator build. Needed before an app can be installed on a device or published anywhere.
signing.noGenerateExplanation: Unlike Android, an Apple Distribution certificate must be issued by Apple itself — import one from your own Apple Developer Program account instead of generating one here.

generating.title: Generating your release…

phase.downloading-jre: Downloading a Java runtime for Android…

generating.doneDescription: Packmaster saved everything to the {{folder}} folder.
generating.errorGeneric: Packmaster couldn't finish generating your release.

info.description: Roves is a web-based game engine that ships your game as a real desktop app instead of a browser tab. Packmaster is the tool that packages it for you.
